name: What should I expect during the drywall clean-up process?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during the drywall clean-up process?

acceptedAnswer.text: During and after drywall installation, dust is a significant byproduct. A professional clean-up typically involves daily sweeping or vacuuming of debris to maintain a workable and somewhat tidy environment. Upon project completion, all drywall scraps, joint compound containers, and other related materials should be removed from the site. The final clean-up will include a thorough sweeping and vacuuming of all surfaces to remove gypsum dust, leaving the area ready for the next phase of construction or finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect ongoing debris removal during installation and a thorough final clean-up, including vacuuming dust and removing all materials.
